seo.description: Sample project: a year-round grounds plan for a Sidney condo strata, with set visits, bed care, hedge trimming and one contact for council. Get a free quote.

summary: A written, year-round grounds plan for a mid-size condo strata near Beacon Avenue.
scope: Mowing and edging on a seasonal schedule
Visit notes to the property manager
story: The council wanted the same standard across the whole year and one person to call when owners had concerns.
We wrote a scope that listed tasks for each visit and a calendar for hedges and cleanups. After each visit the property manager got a short note of what was done and anything that needed a decision.
Read more about [grounds maintenance](/services/grounds-maintenance/), see our work in [Sidney](/areas/sidney/), or [get a free quote](/free-quote/).
result: Council had a written scope to review each season and a single contact for owner concerns.
